text:
adele: Kicking off a mini-sweep for Hydra10B — objective is a low-cost profile that stays within ~2% QA EM of our fp16 baseline. Quick plan: 3 experiment arms (fp8-layerwise, int8-ptq, gguf-hybrid), short eval (1k prompt QA), 3 random seeds. Root job hydra-mini-3498765432.

sam: SGTM. Can you include the baseline config and the 512/2048 seq_len split? Also need latency and $$ est.

maria: I'll run the two seq_len bands (512 / 2048) on A100-80G. Using batch=8, kv-cache warmup=64. ETA ~2.5h for smoke.

ci-bot: Job queued: sweep/hydra-mini-3498765432 (queued on pool "dev-a100-80g", priority medium)

ravi: Quick note: enable per-layer scale clipping for the fp8 pass (last time it avoided divergence on longer sequences). Also set rounding=stochastic for PTQ run.

adele: Checklist to follow (short):
```
- seeds: [0,1,2]
- evalset: quick-1k (mixed QA / summarization / 8k-long QA subset)
- seq_lens: 512, 2048
- kv_cache: enabled, warmup=64
- runtime: batch=8, beam=1
- logging: token-level latency + token usage + per-example EM
- export: gguf for hybrid run with metadata tags
```

sam: Command you used for CI? paste so I can repro locally.

maria: Pasted run command:
```bash
ri run-sweep 
  --model hydra10b 
  --configs fp8-layerwise,int8-ptq,gguf-hybrid 
  --evalset quick-1k 
  --seeds 0,1,2 
  --seq_lens 512,2048 
  --batch 8 
  --notes "mini smoke for cost/quality tradeoffs"
```

adele: Early smoke numbers (seed-avg, quick-1k subset):
- fp16 baseline -> EM 78.4, PPL 12.3, latency 120ms/token, est cost per 1M tokens $720
- int8-ptq -> EM 76.1 (-2.3), PPL 13.0, latency 85ms/token, est cost per 1M tokens $480
- fp8-layerwise -> EM 77.5 (-0.9), PPL 12.6, latency 90ms/token, est cost per 1M tokens $520
- gguf-hybrid -> EM 77.9 (-0.5), PPL 12.5, latency 92ms/token, est cost per 1M tokens $540

sam: Nice — fp8 looks like the sweet spot for small loss + big cost win vs fp16. Can we run a follow-up 5k eval on the fp8/gguf arms and add precision breakdown per layer for fp8?

ravi: Agree. Also add a targeted eval on code-generation prompts — that category regressed more historically with PTQ.

maria: Scheduling follow-up: queued a focused 5k run for fp8-layerwise and gguf-hybrid (job ids queued: hydra-3498765432-fp8-5k, hydra-3498765432-gguf-5k). Will include per-layer stats and output diffs. ETA ~6h.

ci-bot: Jobs started: hydra-3498765432-fp8-5k (node dev-a100-80g-12), hydra-3498765432-gguf-5k (node dev-a100-80g-07)

adele: Next decision criteria (proposal):
- if EM drop <=1% and latency reduction >=20% -> promote fp8 to fastpath candidate
- if EM drop between 1-2% but cost reduction >25% -> consider canary with traffic cap 10%
- if EM drop >2% -> reject PTQ profile for production

sam: I'll add those thresholds to the rollout playbook and start a canary template for fp8 (include automatic rollback if EM delta >1.5% over 24h).

adele: Thanks all — good smoke. Will post full artifact (logs, per-layer stats, gguf blobs) in the model onboarding folder when 5k finishes. :thumbsup:
